published_definition_reproduction.definition: distinct rules with any Match_Datasets.Name or Operations.domain, self-references NOT excluded; guard = a dotted `exists` anywhere in the Check, or a dataset_names/study_domains presence guard

MANIFESTS_FLOOD.note: a NEGATIVE membership/comparison whose reference side comes from the absent dataset -> the reference set folds to EMPTY and EVERY scoped row fires. Unambiguous over-report.

MANIFESTS_ABSENCE_SEMANTIC.note: an emptiness/absence leaf (empty/$op empty, not_exists) that goes true on absence. Often exactly the authored intent -> needs a per-rule authoring judgement, not a blanket fix.

channel_a_note: The CDISC Library carries NO dataset-level Required/Expected/Permissible: `core` is a VARIABLE-level attribute in every pickle under /data/cdisc.metadata.library-cache-pkl. `dataset_always_present` is therefore a labelled STANDARDS JUDGEMENT (ALWAYS_PRESENT in this script), not a cache measurement.

channel_b_SAMPLE_ONLY.warning: SAMPLE. /data/testdata is small and non-representative. Absent here is NOT absent in sponsor data.
